title: On Trying the new method for a season
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：try　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 try 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the musician ① tried the new method for a season on the same day, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the musician ② tries the new method for a season before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ try the new method for a season at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ tried the new method for a season before — a line in the programme for December 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Trying the new method for a season on the same day, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ try three keys before one turned before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Try three keys before one turned at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new listener from the next hall ⑧ tries three keys before one turned on the same day every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the piano, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ tried the new method for a season again when nobody else would.

⑩ To try the new method for a season, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, somebody tries the new method for a season before dawn again and somebody must try the new method for a season on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 尝试（一般过去式 tried the new method for a season：1987 年乐师头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 尝试（一般现在 tries the new method for a season：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 尝试（不定式 to try the new method for a season：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 尝试（过去完成时 had tried the new method for a season：1981 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 尝试（动名词 trying the new method for a season 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 试用（try three keys before one turned：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去试用试了三把钥匙才有一把转动）
G. v. 试用（try three keys before one turned：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 尝试（后段两处：新来的听客照例 tries three keys before one turned，而母亲又一次 tried the new method for a season）

answers.why: try 意为“尝试”，1987 年乐师当天就尝试把新办法试了一季，那是音乐厅里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 tried。
try 意为“尝试”，自那以后乐师天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 tries。
try 意为“尝试”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯尝试把新办法试了一季”，此处为不定式 to try the new method for a season。
try 意为“尝试”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人尝试过，故用过去完成时 had tried。
try 意为“尝试”，乐师说“尝试把新办法试了一季这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 trying the new method for a season 作主语。
try 意为“试用”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去试用试了三把钥匙才有一把转动”，should ever 之后用原形 try three keys before one turned。
try 意为“试用”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻试用试了三把钥匙才有一把转动（try three keys before one turned at once），以后再也不要提起。
try 意为“尝试”，新来的听客每个夜晚都照例试用试了三把钥匙才有一把转动，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 tries。
try 意为“尝试”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就尝试把新办法试了一季，用一般过去式 tried 叙述。
try 意为“尝试”，结尾那句是母亲 1999 年的话：要尝试把新办法试了一季，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和音乐厅记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 try 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the musician tried the new method for a season on the same day, and nobody in the hall forgot it.
Even now the musician tries the new method for a season before dawn whenever the hall asks.
Trying the new method for a season on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever try three keys before one turned before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next hall tries three keys before one turned on the same day every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother tried the new method for a season again, and the hall remembered that half.
